title: Function revealment
statement: Let $f$ be a function on inputs of length $n$ over a finite alphabet, and let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on that alphabet. The function revealment is the infimum, over randomized decision trees that compute $f$ with zero error, of their revealments under $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability distribution on the alphabet.
